Sabse mushkil hai act karne ka faisla; baaki sab bas tenacity hai.
Himmat persistence ki niyyat hai.
Khamoshi wisdom ke liye jagah banati.
Grit andar ki aag hai.
Jo control mein hai usi pe focus karna.
Khamoshi ek prayer ka form hai.
Safalta antim nahi hai, vipalta ghatak nahi hai: aage badhte rehne ka saahas hi maayne rakhta hai.
Darte huye bhi karo.
Silence empty nahi—yeh answers se full hota hai.
Safal vyakti aur anya logon ke beech farak takat ki kami nahi, gyaan ki kami nahi, balki ichcha ki kami hai.
Saahas dar ka virodh hai, dar par kabu hai - dar ki anupasthiti nahi.
Resilience milti nahi, earn hoti hai.
Grit chhote roz marra kaam se naapta.
Strongest log woh jo battles jeet lete, jo humein pata hi nahi.
Himmat matlab phir bhi karna.
Shaant logon ka dimaag sabse shor machata hai.
